_comment: The neighborhoods, map points and table cells on /buyers/best-neighborhoods/ (batch 2026-10-b, page 1). Every cell comes from a verified row in batches/2026-10-b/facts/neighborhoods-facts.md (the verifier's 'OK to use on the page as' wording and the corrected beach rows), except The Farm (batches/2026-10-b/facts/the-farm-facts.md, rows 5, 28, 47, 48, 71), Tidewater's price and fee (batches/2026-10-b/facts/gated-communities-facts.md rows 20 and 43, so the gated page and this page show one value) and the four 55+ communities (batches/2026-10-a/data/55-plus-communities.json, by reference). Prices: the middle recorded resale, October 2025 to September 2026, rounded; a range (the verifier's middle half or full range) where fewer than 20 sold; houses and other types apart where one figure blends them. Fees: the fee sellers entered on listings in October 2026 (The Farm: the HOA's 2026 budget). Beach: minutes by car with no traffic from the neighborhood's middle to the nearest public beach access (The Farm: from the Farmers Rest Drive entrance). Map points: the reference point of each neighborhood (a county address point near the middle of its homes; the address is never shown), The Farm at the middle of its 1,634 parcels.
